one_liner: Google Ads API is free with OAuth 2.0, broad gRPC/REST coverage and an official MCP server; production use requires access-level approval (Explorer/Basic/Standard) per Cloud project.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 user credentials per Google Cloud project; service accounts also supported. Developer tokens were sunset, with access levels now tied to the Cloud project.
access_notes: Enabling the API gives Test access immediately. Explorer access is mostly automated (2,880 ops/day). Basic and Standard need review, and Standard requires meeting RMF.
blocker_notes: Production use across many users needs Basic or Standard access approval, plus brand verification and RMF compliance audits. Test accounts work immediately.

evidence.quote: Creating a Google Cloud project, enabling the Google Ads API, and generating OAuth 2.0 credentials is **100% free**.
automated review and approval in most cases, for up to 2,880 operations per day against production accounts
The Google Ads API is free to use; there are no charges for using the Google Ads API at Explorer access, Basic access, or Standard access levels.
The Google Ads MCP Server exposes MCP Tools and MCP Resources backed by the Google Ads API.
The **Google Ads MCP server** provides a standardized bridge to the Google Ads API.
